method: The ledger records what may be reused and what must stay adapter-owned. Closure uses static evidence, deterministic framework tests, sanitized technical observations and the prior acceptance of finalized ports; it never attributes manual gameplay to the agent or turns source evidence into a universal callback, offset, save path or shutdown action.

source_policy.positive_evidence: Only the five approved source trees named above are positive evidence.
source_policy.unapproved_evidence: WIP, incomplete ports and other source trees are never positive evidence, even when they compile.
source_policy.copy_rule: A mechanism may be copied only after its source contract, target contract, provenance and license are recorded.
source_policy.target_edit_rule: The ledger and framework gate are editable; approved reference ports remain read-only evidence.
source_policy.private_data_rule: No IP address, hostname, credential, personal path or raw device log belongs in this ledger.
